tmdb-slot.name: TMDb
tmdb-slot.description: Shows movie/TV show details above search results.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Key is needed in order to get cast photos, filmography, movie/TV search. Get one at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api

browserLanguage.label: Use browser language
browserLanguage.description: Show overviews, taglines and biographies in the visitor's browser language when TMDB has them.

details.label: Show extra details
details.description: Age rating, runtime or season count, status, genres, tagline and original title.

crew.label: Show director and writer
crew.description: Director and writer for movies, creators for TV shows.

collection.label: Show collection
collection.description: Which film of a series it is. Costs one extra request per movie in a collection.

personBio.label: Show person biography
personBio.description: Photo, birth date, place of birth and biography above a person's filmography.

exactTitle.label: Exact title match
exactTitle.description: Only show titles and people whose name matches the query exactly. Words like "movie" or "series" in the query still allow close matches.

minVotes.label: Minimum votes
minVotes.description: Hide movies and TV shows with fewer TMDB votes than this, so obscure titles that only share a name stay out. Words like "movie" or "series" in the query skip this check. Upcoming titles always show. 0 shows everything.
